paragraphs: Rav Gidal bar Menashia, Moed Katan 24a.
Rav Yehuda bar Menashia, Megillah 14a. Yosi bar Menashia, Megillah ch. 2, halakhah 6. Ulla bar Menashia, Gittin 79a.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The patronymic list contains separate name attestations, not a shared-father identity claim.

Complete named paragraphs attest Rav Gidal bar Menashya in Moed Katan 24a, Rav Yehudah bar Menashya in Megillah 14a, and Ulla bar Menashya reporting Avimi in Gittin 79a. Hyman’s Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 2:6 Yose reference remains unverified in the bounded routing. The list does not establish that these people had one father or share an identity.
